card.name: The word to after advise or tell
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "Advise" or "Tell" plus patients or females of reproductive potential, introducing a counseling instruction. Strongest in contraception advice.

modes.label: Contraception advice
modes.description: "to" after "Advise females of reproductive potential", before "use effective contraception".
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential<< to>> use effective contraception during treatment with LAMP

modes.label: Patient counseling to report or stop
modes.description: "to" after "Advise/Tell patients", before a report or discontinue instruction.
modes.example: Tell patients<< to>> report development of blisters or erosions
